next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR3: report-name-1 is the highest permissible qualifier of LINE-COUNTER, PAGE-COUNTER and every Report Section data-name. 2023: report counters take only 'IN/OF report-name-1' (§2023:8.4.3.15.2), and a qualified data-name is 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] … [ file-report-qualifier ]' (§2023:8.4.2.2.2), the data-qualifiers being superordinate levels in order (§2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR4) and the single report-name last. Same ceiling.
